newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes firm on local buying.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes firm on local buying.

text.p: Local buying amid light volume buoyed CBOT rice futures to a firm close, traders said.
"Local buying supported the market but it was slow with most of the activity late in the session," a trader said.
Most in the trade with ties to the cash market are attending a meeting of the Rice Millers Association in San Diego this week.
That meeting has severely curtailed interest in rice futures, traders said.
Rice closed one to two cents per cwt higher, with July up two at $11.48-1/2 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 150 contracts, below the 246 traded Tuesday.
